newsitem.title: TURKEY: Moderate quake hits eastern Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Moderate quake hits eastern Turkey.

text.p: A moderate earthquake, registering 5.0 on the Richter scale, struck the eastern Turkish provinces of Bingol and Erzerum early on Wednesday, state-run Anatolian news agency said.
There was no immediate report of damage or casualties.
The epicentre of the quake was located at Karliova township, in remote Bingol province, Anatolian said.
A tremor of 5.0 on the Richter scale is powerful enough to cause heavy damage in a populated area.
